# 2 John {.unnumbered}

##### Chapter 1

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
<div class="scripture" data-book="2 John" data-chapter="1">
<p><span class="drop-cap">T</span>he elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth; <span class="verse-number">2</span> For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever. <span class="verse-number">3</span> Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love. <span class="verse-number">4</span> I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father. <span class="verse-number">5</span> And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another. <span class="verse-number">6</span> And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it. <span class="verse-number">7</span> For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist. <span class="verse-number">8</span> Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward. <span class="verse-number">9</span> Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son. <span class="verse-number">10</span> If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed: <span class="verse-number">11</span> For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds. <span class="verse-number">12</span> Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full. <span class="verse-number">13</span> The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.</p>
</div>
:::

\vs{7}For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
\vs{8}Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
\vs{9}Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
\vs{10}If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
